decision.decided_by: Sunjun Hwang, Principal Investigator / Research Lead
decision.decision_procedure: On Development only, compute R-peak minus detected QRS-onset for valid delineations; choose the smallest g in [200, 250, 300] ms with at least 95% of valid onset intervals <= g. If none passes, use 300 ms and report failure of the 95% target. Confirm visually before freezing.
decision.rationale: Full Development count (pre-specified rule, each g's common cohort, valid onsets only): g=200 ms 83/88 = 94.32% (fails 95%); g=250 ms 84/87 = 96.55% (passes); g=300 ms 86/87 = 98.85% (passes). 250 ms is the smallest candidate meeting the pre-specified 95% criterion. Union of Development events in any g's common cohort (129 events, 90 valid onsets) gives the same conclusion (94.4% / 96.7% / 98.9%). Margin is small: two further exceedances at 250 ms would have fallen below 95%.

limitations.onset_detection_failures: 39 of 129 Development common-cohort events (30%) had no valid DWT onset ('onset_missing') and were excluded from the 95% calculation, as the pre-specified rule counts valid onsets only. Failures are concentrated in S219 (20 of 26 events) and S210 (14 of 25); these subjects are therefore under-represented in the g selection.
limitations.events_exceeding_g_star: Three valid-onset Development events have R - onset > 250 ms: 116_164994 (272.2 ms), 116_302281 (286.1 ms), 219_365144 (338.9 ms). For these events g_star = 250 ms does not guarantee that the QRS complex is not cut by the analysis boundary. More generally, per protocol P§1, g mitigates but does not guarantee elimination of QRS boundary cutting. The 219_365144 onset may be a mis-delineation (marker shortly after the preceding beat); not adjudicated.

waveform_review.correction: The earlier review text stated that the green onset markers lay after the 250 ms boundary in all inspected plots. This is corrected: all three events exceeding 250 ms (116_164994, 116_302281, 219_365144) were included in the figures (page_06.png), and in those panels the onset marker lies before (left of) the 250 ms boundary. Also, the 200/250/300 ms boundary lines were drawn in the same colour (left to right: 300, 250, 200 ms), which limited visual discrimination. Record 219 shows baseline wander in some segments; detected onsets there are not asserted to be clinically exact QRS onsets.

decision.delineation_procedure: NeuroKit2 ecg_delineate(method='dwt') for QRS onset, with version and preprocessing parameters as recorded in locked_config.yaml; use Development records only for g selection.

amendments.change: decided_by romanized from the Hangul+romanized form to 'Sunjun Hwang, Principal Investigator / Research Lead'; absolute local decision_file path replaced by the repository-relative path. No change to g_star, stage0 settings, config hash, code hash or any result.
